rules.title: Thin export scope
rules.owner: plasticos_export
rules.statement: `plasticos_export` SHALL own only the missing export-specific booking/shipment context, applicability declarations, views and QWeb report layouts; it SHALL first inspect and reuse existing Odoo/PlasticOS records and SHALL NOT recreate storage, a logistics/dispatch engine, inventory, finance, or a shared document-compliance engine.
rules.positive: An FAS booking is shown with native linked SO/PO, load, evidence and reports; every new export field has a reason for not reusing an existing field.
rules.negative: New export `stock.move`, `mail.queue`, `document.file` or generic `compliance_status` authority is introduced.

rules.title: Single authoritative fact owner
rules.owner: existing native and domain owners
rules.statement: Original bytes/versions belong to native Odoo Documents or approved `ir.attachment` fallback; business evidence classification/verification belong to `plasticos_documents`; purchase/sales and financial facts belong to native Odoo; stock movements belong to native Stock; freight, dispatch and approved external operational mail belong to `plasticos_logistics`/Linda. Export SHALL only bind and display those facts.
rules.positive: Export view shows one current document verdict, one freight status, one stock movement and one posted invoice sourced from the proper owners.
rules.negative: Export stores a second verified flag, shipment stock quantity, actual freight ledger or independently sent mail.

rules.title: Exact associations without mandatory early buyer
rules.owner: Export binding; native commercial owners
rules.statement: All export bookings, sale/purchase order lines, loads, documents, packages and containers SHALL be linked by exact company and typed identity, not guessed partner/name/newest record. A supplier-backed load or owned in-transit inventory MAY have no assigned buyer or sales order until a real sale occurs, subject to the approved procurement/movement authority. An actual customer sale SHALL retain its real buyer. No artificial buyer, sales order, transaction or stock picking SHALL be created merely to satisfy a foreign-key or dispatch constraint.
rules.positive: A company buys and dispatches an approved supplier load with buyer unset; it is held as unallocated stock/in-transit material and later linked to a genuine buyer sale with audit history.
rules.negative: An AI booking auto-link picks the newest transaction from the same supplier, or the dispatcher creates a dummy buyer to proceed.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-08-R001,R007; BRS-POS-05; Logistics BRS-01 owner delta.

rules.title: Evidence proposals are not unauthorized business transitions
rules.owner: native state owner; authorized tool command
rules.statement: Saving or extracting a booking, receiving a file, scanning, or generating a report SHALL NOT directly set a purchase, sale, transaction, stock, load, compliance, financial or regulatory state. A verified source observation MAY request a *named, authorized* state-owner business action if exact scope, preconditions, idempotency, and actor permissions are satisfied. The authoritative owner SHALL enforce the transition and return accepted/refused with reason and provenance; no direct state write or bypass is allowed.
rules.positive: An exactly matched, verified booking updates its booking context; an explicitly permitted documented transition is performed only through an authorized guarded business action.
rules.negative: AI marks transaction delivered/invoiced when it reads a booking PDF, or a controller writes `state` directly.

rules.title: Capability proof and deployment independence
rules.owner: Odoo deployment/license owner
rules.statement: Before depending on Enterprise Documents, Inventory Barcode, AI/OCR or IoT device features, installation, licensing and actual installed API SHALL be verified; where the approved build lacks a capability, Export SHALL use an explicitly approved native fallback or keep it unavailable rather than fabricate or silently require it.
rules.positive: A CE environment records its supported attachment workflow and marks Enterprise-only features unavailable.
rules.negative: Export refuses to install because a speculative Documents AI action is mandatory or claims scanning was proven.

rules.title: Booking-to-order and shipment cardinality independent
rules.owner: plasticos_export booking association; native commercial and Logistics identities
rules.statement: A booking SHALL have an authoritative typed company and revision context and MAY relate to one or more physical containers/movements according to the real carrier reservation. One Sales Order or Purchase Order MAY be fulfilled by many loads and distinct bookings; a physical shipment SHALL be linked to its applicable booking and exact order-line/fulfillment allocation without requiring the entire SO or PO to be one shipment. The booking, drayage load, ISO container, seal, stock package/lot and order remain separate identities. A new booking model is conditional on reuse evidence.
rules.positive: One SO for 30 loads and one supplier PO for four weekly loads can show four separate bookings and individual receipts without duplicating orders or quantities.
rules.negative: Each new booking clones the PO or SO; the only `transaction.load_id` is overwritten by the fourth physical load.

rules.title: Six first-class booking values
rules.owner: plasticos_export for gaps only
rules.statement: Booking No., Steamship Line, Port of Loading, Port of Discharge, Cut Off and Earliest Return Date SHALL be first-class searchable/displayable booking information when supplied; existing authoritative fields SHALL be reused before creating storage. Booking No. remains an unmodified string; Steamship Line SHALL be distinct from forwarder and drayage carrier; POL/POD SHALL be distinct from terminal, rail ramp and final destination.
rules.positive: An external booking notice supplies all six, and an operator can retrieve it by exact booking number and steamship line.
rules.negative: A numeric booking field drops leading zeros or Port of Discharge is overwritten with buyer destination.

rules.title: ERD and cargo cutoff semantics
rules.owner: plasticos_export schedule context
rules.statement: Earliest Return Date SHALL represent the effective earliest permitted loaded-container receiving/gate-in window for the stated booking and facility; Cut Off SHALL represent its stated cargo/terminal acceptance deadline. ERD, cargo cutoff, shipping-instruction cutoff, VGM cutoff, documentation, rail and filing deadlines SHALL remain distinct. A booking without a supplied timestamp SHALL remain date-only or unknown, without invented time-of-day.
rules.positive: A carrier supplies date-only ERD and an 18:00 terminal-local cargo cutoff; the system keeps their different precision and purpose.
rules.negative: ERD is misused as the empty-container return date or SI cutoff silently replaces cargo cutoff.

rules.title: Schedule source, revisions and time zones
rules.owner: plasticos_export schedule context + native document provenance
rules.statement: Each booking schedule assertion SHALL retain exact source/original reference, reporter, observed time, terminal/local time zone, value precision, effective revision and supersession. A later email SHALL NOT silently overwrite a confirmed cutoff/ERD, and conflicting carrier/terminal notices SHALL remain visible until the responsible party resolves them.
rules.positive: An amended cutoff preserves both notice originals and displays current confirmed value with its source and timezone.
rules.negative: Old screenshot silently wins a race against a verified terminal advisory or date-only value becomes 00:00.

rules.title: Operational readiness is a projection
rules.owner: plasticos_export view/exception projection
rules.statement: Export schedule and readiness views SHALL derive status from current booking evidence, native load/stock status and verified document applicability without becoming a second source of physical or regulatory state. A schedule conflict, missing applicable proof or expired acceptance window SHALL produce an attributed exception; an observed gate event is not automatically legal delivery/risk transfer.
rules.positive: Cutoff passes with no terminal acceptance record: dashboard shows at-risk/pending and retains source status.
rules.negative: Booking label changes from Planned to Delivered merely because a cargo cutoff is in the past.

rules.title: Commercial label is not a legal Incoterm
rules.owner: native Odoo order/contract + export display
rules.statement: The recycler trade labels `FOB` (buyer pickup), `FAS` (seller-included freight to agreed port/rail), and `CNF`/`C&F` SHALL be preserved as quoted business usage separately from any explicitly contracted formal ICC Incoterm and named place. Booking arranger, payer, contracted handoff and exporter/filing role SHALL be explicit facts, not inferred from either shorthand. Export SHALL never silently rewrite an order Incoterm.
rules.positive: Industry FOB pickup and a formal FCA term can be stored distinctly when the actual contract supports both.
rules.negative: Selecting FAS sets official ICC FAS risk transfer at rail gate or turns on seller ocean freight automatically.

rules.title: Native intake, AI-proposed extraction and exact document attribution
rules.owner: native Documents intake; plasticos_documents exact evidence link
rules.statement: Booking confirmations, amendments, gate receipts, emails and other originals SHALL enter through native Documents/approved attachments and retain original bytes, versions and attributable metadata. Odoo 19 AI document facilities MAY extract proposed typed booking values and candidate relations, but SHALL NOT auto-commit a partner-only or newest-open-record guess. The document owner SHALL resolve the exact company, booking, intended physical shipment and valid revision (or hold for review) before Export consumes facts; no duplicate original store or verifier.
rules.positive: Four weekly bookings from the same Charleston supplier are independently extracted and attached to their correct load/booking without cross-linking.
rules.negative: AI auto-sort associates each document with the latest open transaction for Waste Management or silently replaces the original.

rules.title: Applicability belongs to export, verdict to Documents
rules.owner: export applicability / `plasticos_documents` verification
rules.statement: Export SHALL declare which document categories are required for the specific booking, phase, agreement, party, stage and requested operation. `plasticos_documents` SHALL own whether exact current evidence meets those requirements and whether an authorized override applies. Export SHALL consume that verdict, never author its own verified/compliant status or second rule evaluator.
rules.positive: Phase 1 FAS requires terminal gate receipt for a particular handoff; Documents says missing until verified current evidence arrives.
rules.negative: Any upload unconditionally flips an export `documents_complete` stored flag despite invalid source evidence.

rules.title: No duplicate verification action
rules.owner: `plasticos_documents`
rules.statement: Native Documents UI/actions SHALL delegate business verification, refusal and override to one approved `plasticos_documents` owner with attributable actor, source/version and scope; Export SHALL be read-only for the verification result. Existing duplicated native `verified` actions SHALL be reconciled at the Documents owner before Export relies on their output.
rules.positive: Native view and PlasticOS evidence show one identical approved verdict.
rules.negative: Native verify button writes its own independent verified truth and Export accepts it without the business owner.

rules.title: Native export-specific reports
rules.owner: plasticos_export QWeb layout / native source values
rules.statement: Export MAY own only export-specific QWeb report templates and view composition (booking/dispatch sheet, container/package packing list, exceptions, outbound document packet). Data SHALL come from the current native sales, stock, logistics, booking and verified Documents owners; reports SHALL be version-aware, audience-safe and shall not impersonate a third-party issued B/L or certification.
rules.positive: Booking sheet and packing list print exact booking revision and native package weights without changing inventory.
rules.negative: Generating a packing list overwrites actual stock weight or forges a carrier-issued ocean B/L.

rules.title: Linda owns external sends
rules.owner: `plasticos_logistics` / Linda using native Odoo Mail
rules.statement: An export screen MAY request an authorized outgoing report, booking reply, document request or amendment through the approved existing Linda/Odoo Mail operation. Export SHALL NOT send, retry, chase, or separately schedule the same external correspondence; queued, sent and unknown delivery outcomes SHALL remain distinct and attributable.
rules.positive: One report is sent once with approved recipient/edition and Odoo mail evidence.
rules.negative: Export calls its own SMTP or resends a message whose delivery status is unknown while Linda is also sending.

rules.title: Missing documents use existing activity owners
rules.owner: `plasticos_documents`/native Activity; Linda external reminders
rules.statement: A missing or invalid export-required file SHALL appear as one scoped Documents compliance exception and the appropriate native internal Activity/Request; any approved external chase uses the existing Linda obligation and native scheduler. Export SHALL NOT add a recurring document-chase cron or another reminder ledger.
rules.positive: Missing gate receipt generates one internal review item and, if explicitly approved, a single Linda outreach episode.
rules.negative: Documents, Export and Linda each send a separate external request for the same receipt.

rules.title: Correct document type and actual obligation
rules.owner: export applicability / document type owner
rules.statement: The required file set SHALL depend on actual booking, cargo, contract, destination/transit jurisdiction and responsible party; Phase 1 shall not require every Phase 2 ocean document. Domestic truck BOL, carrier-issued ocean B/L, verified gross mass evidence, commercial invoice and filings SHALL be separately classified and attributed; a file received is not a valid approval merely by existing.
rules.positive: A port/rail FAS sale is eligible for terminal handoff review without a fictitious issued ocean B/L when its actual obligation does not require one.
rules.negative: An export-ready badge assumes every BOL is an issued ocean B/L or unconditionally demands foreign customs paperwork in Phase 1.

rules.title: FOB buyer pickup as industry operation
rules.owner: commercial order + `plasticos_logistics`
rules.statement: Phase 1 SHALL support `FOB pickup` in the operator’s recycling trade meaning: buyer/agent arranges pickup at the agreed origin. Export MAY display linked booking evidence when supplied but SHALL NOT require ocean booking data or seller-arranged freight for every FOB pickup. Pickup, carrier and physical dispatch remain existing logistics/stock operations.
rules.positive: A buyer-arranged truck pickup completes with actual pickup evidence and no ocean booking.
rules.negative: FOB pickup refuses to operate until Steamship Line and Port of Discharge are populated.

rules.title: FAS inland freight-included delivery
rules.owner: commercial order + `plasticos_logistics`
rules.statement: Phase 1 SHALL support `FAS delivered port/rail` in the operator’s established recycling trade meaning: seller includes the agreed inland transportation to the identified port/rail destination. It SHALL expose booking details and timing when relevant, reusing existing carrier/freight/load authority; it SHALL NOT infer seller ocean freight or substitute the formal ICC FAS risk-transfer point.
rules.positive: A seller-arranged drayage load reaches specified rail/port handoff, with separately verified gate/delivery evidence.
rules.negative: A truck is scheduled, and Export marks ocean freight paid or formal alongside-vessel legal delivery proven.

rules.title: Physical handoff and commercial allocation are independent
rules.owner: Logistics and native Stock; Documents verification; Export projection
rules.statement: Each Phase 1 movement SHALL preserve actual pickup, gate/rail acceptance, named handoff place and source evidence independently of whether a buyer is already allocated. An owned supplier-backed movement with no assigned buyer is an eligible commercial scenario only when its separate authorization and destination/booking requirements are satisfied. Sale order fulfillment or invoicing may occur later under its own native authority; terminal arrival, gate acceptance and legal transfer are distinct.
rules.positive: An authorized FAS-style shipment reaches the rail ramp with buyer allocation pending; physical evidence is retained and no customer invoice is posted until a genuine sale permits it.
rules.negative: Gate-in retroactively creates a customer sale, or the load is marked delivered to a nonexistent buyer facility.

rules.title: ERD-to-cutoff dispatch visibility
rules.owner: export schedule view + Linda
rules.statement: Where a live booking or terminal appointment exists, Phase 1 SHALL present its current sourced ERD/cargo cutoff window and risk exception to the responsible coordinator. Changes SHALL not independently modify a Linda commitment, dispatch, or send an amendment; these are coordinated through the existing owner.
rules.positive: Carrier revises ERD after a pickup is proposed; operator sees the conflict and existing dispatcher receives a legitimate action.
rules.negative: Schedule change silently modifies a confirmed carrier rate or sends multiple reschedule emails.

rules.title: Native documents and simple views first
rules.owner: `plasticos_export` views/report layout
rules.statement: The Phase 1 export UI SHALL prioritize a booking/shipment list/form, ERD and cargo cutoff visibility, missing-evidence exceptions, a linked document view and a small set of native export reports. A dedicated new export workflow engine or complex overseas tracking UI is out of scope.
rules.positive: Staff complete a real FAS booking and review source docs through one simple view plus existing Odoo records.
rules.negative: Phase 1 requires a new event bus, overseas vessel polling or independent compliance ledger to generate a dispatch sheet.

rules.title: In-transit sale reuses original shipment and evidence
rules.owner: native commercial sale and inventory owner; Export link/projection
rules.statement: Phase 2 SHALL support a genuine buyer purchasing material already on the water, including later sale-order allocation to existing identified cargo while preserving original purchase, container, booking, stock custody, delivery, and documents. The seller/buyer, title terms, Incoterm, approval and pricing SHALL be governed by the real native commercial owner and contract. No new parallel shipment/stock ledger or retroactive falsification of historic transport facts is permitted.
rules.positive: A container already sailed without a buyer is later allocated to an approved international SO with a traceable effective date and unchanged carrier documents.
rules.negative: A late sale rewrites the original booking party or shipping date, automatically assumes customs clearance, or creates a second stock quant.

rules.title: Freight-inclusive price/role semantics
rules.owner: native commercial order + `plasticos_logistics`
rules.statement: Phase 2 SHALL support recycler `CNF/C&F` trade shorthand, and explicit contractual CFR/CIF terms where agreed, while preserving booking arranger, freight payer, ocean carrier/forwarder, insurer when applicable, seller obligations and agreed destination separately. Freight quotes/actuals remain with existing logistics/accounting owners; terms SHALL NOT alone infer title transfer or risk at destination.
rules.positive: A CFR shipment shows seller ocean freight responsibility and risk recorded separately from arrival.
rules.negative: CNF label automatically posts freight bill or treats arrival at POD as first transfer of risk.

rules.title: Ocean milestones are sourced facts
rules.owner: `plasticos_export` contextual projection / third-party evidence
rules.statement: Phase 2 MAY expose verified vessel/voyage, container loading, port departure, discharge, delivery and exception information where carrier/forwarder data is actually supplied; each observation SHALL retain source and revision, and SHALL NOT overwrite native stock, freight or customer delivery authority.
rules.positive: Ocean B/L and carrier departure notice can be correlated to a booking/container and displayed as source-backed milestones.
rules.negative: An ETD estimate automatically marks vessel sailed, invoice paid or cargo received.

rules.title: Ocean B/L, shipping instructions and VGM
rules.owner: native Documents + document compliance + export applicability
rules.statement: Phase 2 SHALL coordinate applicable shipping instructions, issued ocean B/L (carrier/forwarder original), required VGM evidence and export packet documents using native original custody and shared verification. Export SHALL NOT forge or issue a carrier B/L, assert VGM compliance from package-net sum alone, or add a separate document verifier.
rules.positive: A third-party-issued B/L is linked and verified for the exact ocean container; VGM proof names its method and signer when required.
rules.negative: An export PDF labels itself carrier-issued B/L or treats QR weights alone as verified gross mass.

rules.title: Applicable regulated filings and filing actors
rules.owner: external filing authority + native Documents evidence
rules.statement: Where material, destination, transit, and law require export filings, permits, consents or jurisdiction-specific documents, Phase 2 SHALL record the applicable decision, responsible exporter/filer, authority and evidence/status with explicit attribution. It SHALL NOT auto-approve material legality, submit AES/customs filings or claim a compliance clearance without authorized integration and verified real result.
rules.positive: Shipment needing an export filing retains the filer, authority acceptance reference and approved evidence.
rules.negative: Shipment is marked compliant because the upload filename contains the word approved.

rules.title: Phase 2 operations remain native-first
rules.owner: native Odoo + Linda + Documents
rules.statement: Export SHALL reuse native multi-currency orders, accounting, payments, stock, existing freight/dispatch and document operations for international selling; destination-milestone and report requirements SHALL not cause duplicate finance, carrier mail, scheduler, stock or new payment state machine.
rules.positive: A CIF invoice remains Odoo accounting, with separate marine insurance evidence and native financial posting approval.
rules.negative: Ocean release triggers a new export cash ledger or duplicates Linda scheduled reminders.

rules.title: Audience/confidentiality and company isolation
rules.owner: native Odoo ACLs + Documents/Linda owners
rules.statement: Every booking, document link, generated report, outgoing recipient and related stock/order lookup SHALL enforce the exact company and approved audience. Supplier economics, buyer identity, freight economics and sensitive documents SHALL NOT leak across a brokered trade or company boundary; Export SHALL not grant external Documents access.
rules.positive: Forwarder booking sheet contains authorized load details without exposing hidden supplier buy price.
rules.negative: A read-only export user can download every native Documents original or a buyer sees supplier invoice.

rules.title: Unknown and contradictory evidence remains visible
rules.owner: export projections with source owner decisions
rules.statement: Missing, wrong-party, stale, superseded, conflicted or uncertain export evidence SHALL remain UNKNOWN/pending with an attributed exception. Export SHALL NOT use fuzzy linking, optimistic defaults or AI/OCR inferences to declare a validated booking, shipment, compliant document, gate acceptance or regulatory result.
rules.positive: Carrier and terminal disagree on Cut Off; both originals are retained and action is assigned for verification.
rules.negative: The newest unauthenticated email silently changes the confirmed booking and makes it green.

rules.title: Order, shipment, evidence and transaction states remain scoped
rules.owner: native commercial/state owners; Export read-only projection
rules.statement: Purchase/Sale ordered quantity, each physical receipt/dispatch, each booking/terminal milestone, document verification, transaction state, invoicing and financial settlement SHALL remain independent and scoped to the correct child/line. One of four weekly loads delivered SHALL NOT mark the entire four-load PO fulfilled nor a 30-load SO delivered. AI may propose a transition but the existing validated state owner SHALL apply it only if the explicitly required evidence, quantities and authorization permit it.
rules.positive: A first-week load has a verified gate receipt while three future PO quantities remain open and the 30-load SO remains partially fulfilled.
rules.negative: One extracted booking or scanned container marks its parent transaction and all sibling loads Delivered/Closed, or invoices all remaining quantities.

rules.title: Minimality and acceptance gate
rules.owner: product owner/repository implementation owner
rules.statement: A future proposed export field, model, menu, QWeb report, cron or automation SHALL carry a source-owner census, a concrete unmet business action and one positive plus one failure acceptance case. Rules are planning requirements until separately admitted and implemented. Each real test SHALL cite its BRS ID, exact repo revision and observed evidence; no unrun scenario may be labeled PASS.
rules.positive: A future export PR maps each changed file to a rule and shows no duplicate sender/verifier/stock writer under tests.
rules.negative: A new generic document engine is approved solely because a QWeb template could not find a field.

rules.title: Safe change and activation boundaries
rules.owner: operator + live owner of each capability
rules.statement: The export BRS pack SHALL not itself install a module, activate mail or cron, create shipment transactions, approve legal filings or change Native-First BRS semantics. Any implementation/cutover requires a bounded separately authorized contract; changes to prior locked decisions require explicit dated supersession, preserving old rules and acceptance trace.
rules.positive: The BRS pack can be reviewed with all operational services unchanged.
rules.negative: Publishing a document BRS silently enables Linda email or makes a compliance rule legally operative.

rules.title: Equipment vocabulary differentiates road trailers from ocean containers
rules.owner: Logistics transport equipment classification; Export uses scoped choices
rules.statement: The transport equipment selections SHALL distinguish domestic road trailers from maritime freight containers. It SHALL NOT conflate vehicle/trailer identity, ISO container identity, shipping booking identity, Odoo stock package identity, or an internal load. A chassis carrying an ocean container remains a ground transport leg associated with a distinct maritime container.
rules.positive: A 40HC container travels on a chassis to a terminal while its ISO container number, drayage load, booking and scanned cargo packages remain distinct.
rules.negative: A stock.package, trailer number or booking number substitutes for ISO container identity or its truck chassis.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-01-R001,R002; BRS-EXP-02-R001; PlasticOS native stock/load boundaries

rules.title: Supported domestic trailer choices
rules.owner: Logistics transport equipment; Export references for terminal drayage if applicable
rules.statement: Domestic dispatch SHALL support 53-foot trailers, 48-foot trailers and flatbeds. Flatbeds SHALL be a type independent of any assumed universal length; dimensions and restrictions MAY be specified for the actual move. Export SHALL NOT create a second domestic trailer catalog or dispatch process.
rules.positive: Operator can specify a 53-foot trailer, 48-foot trailer or flatbed on native logistics movement and find it through the related export booking if relevant.
rules.negative: Flatbed automatically means 48-foot, or Export creates a duplicate domestic load and rate workflow.

rules.title: Supported ocean container choices with a preference, not a hard constraint
rules.owner: Export booking presentation; shared logistics equipment semantics
rules.statement: Export booking choices SHALL include 40-foot high cube (40HC), 40-foot standard (40STD), 45-foot high cube (45HC), 45-foot standard (45STD) and 20-foot standard (20STD). For the operator's plastic exports, 40HC SHALL be the default suggested option, not an enforced selection. 20STD SHALL remain selectable for metal recyclers without precluding other cargo. Supported-in-UI does not assert steamship-line, route, port, or chassis availability.
rules.positive: Plastic booking suggests 40HC; metal export can explicitly choose 20STD; 40STD, 45HC and 45STD remain separately selectable when offered.
rules.negative: The system silently converts a requested 45STD to 45HC, bans a 20STD for non-metal cargo, or asserts any type is universally bookable.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-02-R001,R002; carrier confirmation remains external evidence

rules.title: Booking equipment count and per-week physical units
rules.owner: Export reservation; Logistics actual movements; native Stock cargo
rules.statement: A booking SHALL capture requested container equipment and count; physical units SHALL separately retain ISO number, seal, actual equipment, native stock packages and linked movement/load identity. Several containers MAY share one booking; distinct weekly movements MAY each have their own booking even when they share one PO and SO. Requested/actual equipment amendments SHALL not overwrite other siblings or invent copy-per-unit cargo weight.
rules.positive: One SO covers four weekly shipments with four booking numbers; a later booking includes two distinct 40HC containers each with its own seal and loading evidence.
rules.negative: Changing week 3 equipment silently edits week 1 container or copies full shipment tonnage to both containers.

rules.title: Reuse only the correct equipment owner and native records
rules.owner: Logistics transport master/native shipping record; Export only booking-specific fields
rules.statement: Before adding any transport-type persistence, inspect native Odoo delivery/shipping and existing PlasticOS Logistics fields and extend the canonical owner only for an actual gap. `plasticos.equipment.type` is an existing FACILITY production/handling equipment registry (balers, granulators, etc.) and SHALL NOT be repurposed as a freight-container type registry. `plasticos_export` SHALL NOT create a competing universal equipment master, stock package, carrier record or transport engine.
rules.positive: A missing transport type is defined once at the appropriate logistics/native transport owner and Export uses a reference; facility granulator capabilities remain untouched.
rules.negative: Export seeds ocean sizes into facility equipment types or clones an overlapping equipment catalog.

rules.title: Do not infer payload, capacity or VGM from nominal equipment name
rules.owner: Physical weight: native Odoo Stock and verified scale evidence; Export displays source facts
rules.statement: Equipment labels SHALL NOT imply a fixed cargo limit or certified legal weight. Actual scale observations, package net/tare, container tare, gross, lashing/packing weight where applicable, local carrier/road/port constraints, and any valid VGM evidence SHALL retain their respective sources, units, revisions and verification. Export SHALL NOT derive a certified VGM or commercial settlement quantity solely from scanned package weights or from a 40HC/20STD selection.
rules.positive: A 40HC shipment includes current package totals and independently attributed container tare/VGM evidence when required, without altering supplier/buyer settlement authority.
rules.negative: 40HC code automatically inserts a universal max payload, self-certifies VGM or writes invoice weights.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-03; BRS-POS weight authority; VGM governed outside equipment catalogue

rules.title: Equipment discrepancy and booking amendment are explicit
rules.owner: Export booking contextual exception; Documents evidence; Logistics physical movements
rules.statement: A mismatch between requested and supplied equipment SHALL be reported with provenance and require an authorized booking amendment or explicit exception resolution. Confirmed equipment type and actual container ID SHALL follow physical evidence. Export SHALL not rebook, dispatch, email the carrier, change stock, change the Incoterm or cancel a booking merely because an equipment selection changes.
rules.positive: Carrier assigns 40STD instead of requested 40HC; the booking view shows discrepancy and a sourced operator approval before documentation is finalized.
rules.negative: Export silently changes freight/dispatch and sends a replacement carrier instruction on a dropdown edit.

rules.title: Reports and loading must use exact units without duplicate inventory
rules.owner: Export views/QWeb; native Stock physical movement; Documents evidence/verification
rules.statement: Booking screens, loading/packing reports and associated documents SHALL display requested equipment, confirmed equipment, count and each actual container ID/seal as available, sourced from their owner. QR scans SHALL continue to update native Odoo stock/package movements and per-container loading evidence, not an export-owned inventory ledger. Blank/unconfirmed equipment or ambiguous load association SHALL display Unknown/Needs Review instead of inventing capacity, seal or departure status.
rules.positive: Packing list for one of two booked containers lists exactly the scanned inventory packages, distinct seal and observed weight with unresolved fields clearly shown.
rules.negative: A booking-level 40HC field copies all 40,000 lb onto each of two containers, or report assumes goods are shipped before verified stock dispatch.

rules.title: Buyer optional before a genuine sale
rules.owner: native Purchase/Stock + permitted Logistics movement authority
rules.statement: A purchase, real owned material, or authorized physical export movement MAY be recorded and progressed without a buyer, customer SO, or assigned end buyer when no sale exists. Supplier, company, approval, stock/custody, movement purpose, destination and applicable booking shall be real; buyer-dependent rules still apply to actual customer-sale release. No fake buyer/order or implied sale shall be used to bypass validation.
rules.positive: Buyerless purchased material is received or drayed on authorized records, remains unsold and traceable, then is sold later.
rules.negative: Buyer is mandatory at every physical movement, or system auto-creates a dummy buyer to start freight.

rules.title: One large customer commitment with smaller supply orders
rules.owner: native `sale.order`/`purchase.order` lines
rules.statement: One real buyer commitment (example: customer PO represented by one SO for 30 MRP loads) SHALL be fulfillable through multiple suppliers, supplier POs, and physical shipments. A supplier PO for 4 loads SHALL coexist with that 30-load SO without requiring four separate supplier POs; customer PO evidence is not a supplier PO.
rules.positive: One 30-load customer SO and one four-load Waste Management supplier PO are both represented natively with correct counterparties and quantities.
rules.negative: Each new weekly truck creates a new SO or PO, or the buyer PO is mistaken for the supplier PO.

rules.title: Partial purchase fulfillment without PO duplication
rules.owner: native Odoo Purchase and Stock receipt/picking owner
rules.statement: A supplier PO MAY authorize multiple separately ready and executed loads across weeks. Native receipt/backorder and delivered/remaining quantity mechanics SHALL be used for each physically executed quantity; the PO obligation remains open for its unfulfilled balance. No Export-created parallel purchase/receipt counters.
rules.positive: One supplier PO for four planned loads is received across four weekly stock operations and correctly shows three remaining after week 1.
rules.negative: First receipt closes the PO or Export issues a new PO to substitute for an approved backorder.

rules.title: Partial sales fulfillment and reserved allocation
rules.owner: native Odoo Sales and Stock delivery/move lines
rules.statement: A customer SO MAY be fulfilled by multiple suppliers and many loads; native reserved/delivered/unfulfilled quantities SHALL remain authoritative per order line and valid UoM. If a buyer is not yet assigned, cargo remains unallocated to a sale until real contract approval. A shipment association SHALL NOT alone validate its stock picking.
rules.positive: After shipping one eligible load the SO still has 29 load-equivalents open (subject to actual UoM) and a later shipment can satisfy more.
rules.negative: Assigning a booking decrements SO deliveries, auto-delivers the rest, or books sold quantity before approved allocation.

rules.title: Independent booking per execution and container cardinality
rules.owner: Export booking and Logistics exact shipment links
rules.statement: One PO/SO may correspond to many bookings and loads; a single booking may cover multiple physical containers. A shipment SHALL identify its exact booking revision; no global one-to-one order-booking rule or single `transaction.load_id` may be used as the only association for a multi-load order. Define the smallest source-owned many-side association after a full cardinality census.
rules.positive: Four weekly physical loads under one PO have four distinct booking confirmations and dates, each linked to the correct shipment.
rules.negative: Booking number replaces load ID, or a fourth load overwrites the first three links.

rules.title: Fulfillment allocation is traceable without second quantity ledger
rules.owner: native Stock/Purchase/Sales actual lines; Export typed linkage
rules.statement: When a real order spans shipments or cargo is resold in transit, maintain exact links and quantities between the participating native PO/SO order lines, pickings/moves, shipment/load, container and applicable booking. No allocation may exceed authoritative available/contracted quantities; corrections, splits and reversals SHALL be attributed and must prevent double allocation.
rules.positive: One four-load PO has four traceable executed quantities each linked to separate bookings, and a received load cannot be allocated twice to SOs.
rules.negative: Export stores editable aggregate inventory or allows the same stock quantity to satisfy two sales orders.

rules.title: Late buyer assignment and on-water resale
rules.owner: native commercial owner; stock custody; Export historic association
rules.statement: Buyer allocation MAY occur after pickup, terminal delivery or ocean sailing when a legal sale is entered and approved. The exact cargo/container/booking remains unchanged; the new sale association retains effective timestamps, actor, source contract, company and audit history. Change of physical destination or regulatory party requires independent logistics/filing authority and cannot be inferred from buyer allocation.
rules.positive: An unsold container already afloat is sold and linked to a new buyer SO without rewriting its prior gate-in or departure facts.
rules.negative: Sale order date backdates the ocean booking or changing buyer silently changes delivery partner, customs filer or original B/L.

rules.title: Movement eligibility by purpose, not a universal buyer predicate
rules.owner: Logistics and native authorization owner, not Export
rules.statement: Movement release SHALL distinguish sale-backed delivery from approved procurement-owned/in-transit stock relocation or export drayage. Sales movements require a real buyer/SO when that workflow mandates it; lawful buyerless movements require approved company, supplier PO/owned stock authority, route/destination, cargo, applicable booking and permission. Logistics SHALL not rely on `sale_order_id` as the only possible company identity or on one transaction load field as the only exact movement link.
rules.positive: A supplier-approved buyerless booking uses a company-authorized Logistics movement while ordinary sale dispatch still rejects an absent buyer.
rules.negative: A generic removal of all buyer checks allows unidentified company/cargo or dispatch without commercial approval.

rules.title: Use Odoo native AI Documents before custom extraction
rules.owner: native Odoo Documents AI, installed capability verified
rules.statement: When the approved Odoo 19 Enterprise AI Documents capability is available, incoming booking confirmations and amendments SHALL be classified and candidate booking data extracted through that native facility, not a parallel Export OCR/doc ingestion engine. Actual installed APIs, AI licensing/permissions, coverage and fallback SHALL be verified before activation; if unavailable, permit controlled manual booking entry.
rules.positive: A carrier booking PDF enters native Documents and yields editable candidate data with the original retained.
rules.negative: Export introduces a second file storage/OCR pipeline or claims unverified AI integration works in CE.
rules.cross_references: Odoo 19 AI Document sort; BRS-POS-02; BRS-EXP-01-R005.

rules.title: Typed field extraction with source-level provenance
rules.owner: native AI candidate intake; export booking field owner
rules.statement: Native Odoo AI SHALL extract candidate values from both message body and attachments with explicit origin: purchase order reference, booking No., shipping line, POL/POD when present, ERD, terminal/cargo cutoff, equipment quantity/type, vessel/voyage, empty pickup and loaded return locations, dates, ticket, actual container/seal, reported weights and document requirements. Preserve exact strings including leading zeros, distinguishing time/date precision, reporter, field source and confidence. An absent field is UNKNOWN, never filled from a nearby attachment or assumption.
rules.positive: PO 64014 and Booking 6509024800 are extracted from separate files, with 1 x 40HQ, 10/05 ERD and 10/09 16:00 cutoff traced to the dated booking PDF; missing POL/POD remain unknown rather than inferred from Long Beach terminal.
rules.negative: AI mistakes order 64014 for ocean Booking No., infers POD from container destination, or converts date-only ERD into an exact midnight appointment.

rules.title: Exact company-and-booking match, never latest partner
rules.owner: PlasticOS Documents exact link and Export booking lookup
rules.statement: Before assigning an extracted fact, resolve company, source thread, exact PO/order and applicable booking revision, shipment/load and actual physical container/ticket via corroborated typed identifiers. Multiple bookings may reference one PO; booking identity alone does not identify a physical load before container/ticket linkage. Party-only, latest-open transaction and PDF filename matches are not sufficient. A conflict or unresolved one-to-many case enters a review/exception queue without incorrect downstream writes.
rules.positive: The scale ticket and spreadsheet both specify PO 64014, booking 6509024800, ticket 1728952 and container CSNU8490558, resolving that specific physical load without attaching four other future loads.
rules.negative: An email from the same supplier links an amended booking to the most recent transaction or globally changes all five PO loads.

rules.title: Ambiguity, conflicting originals and correction review
rules.owner: Documents verification owner; authorized export booking reviewer
rules.statement: When several candidate bookings, loads, companies, amended notices, or inconsistent ERD/cutoff fields are possible, AI SHALL abstain from authoritative writes and create a reviewable exception with candidate IDs and conflicting originals. A verified, authorized actor SHALL resolve exact linkage or reject it; the superseded/original evidence remains accessible.
rules.positive: Two similar bookings share a carrier and supplier; ambiguous PDF waits in an exact-match review queue without changing either shipment.
rules.negative: AI guesses the most recent load or changes all four siblings on a single ambiguous booking email.

rules.title: Version-safe, idempotent apply
rules.owner: Export booking owner; native Documents original/version keeper
rules.statement: Native intake SHALL deduplicate identical original document bytes and email events while retaining distinct versions even when filenames repeat. AI SHALL classify a newly observed booking-related notice as initial confirmation, same-booking revision/roll, cancellation, replacement-booking cross-reference, or supplemental capacity only when evidence suffices; otherwise retain unresolved as a proposal. Prior originals and values remain queryable. A material booking change shall trigger only exact affected downstream reassessment, never automatic carrier rebooking, blanket load cancellation or commercial PO reissue.
rules.positive: A later two-container ERD/cutoff email is held as a candidate revision of the earlier one-container booking until same-booking identity/authority is verified; a confirmed roll supersedes only the affected booking revision.
rules.negative: AI assumes the latest email is an authoritative replacement despite missing booking number or overwrites a September original because the PDF has the same filename.

rules.title: Apply structured values only through approved owner interface
rules.owner: Export booking/record owner; Documents extraction producer
rules.statement: The AI component SHALL output an extraction proposal to a bounded write action that checks company, actor permission, field ownership, exact target, revision precondition and required evidence. Only fields owned by Export MAY be written there; original document classification/verification stays with Documents, transport facts with Logistics, contract values with Sales/Purchase, and stock with Inventory.
rules.positive: Confirmed booking extraction updates the exact booking record and its linked view without mutating a purchase order or load freight rate.
rules.negative: An AI server action directly writes arbitrary model/field values, bypasses access controls or sets Documents verified=true.
rules.cross_references: Odoo 19 AI Server Actions documentation; BRS-EXP-01-R002.

rules.title: Transaction/load state changes only via validated commands
rules.owner: native state transition owner (Transaction/Logistics/Stock/Accounting)
rules.statement: Document-derived supplier readiness, loaded shipment confirmation, carrier acknowledgment, terminal/rail acceptance, vessel departure and booking cancellation SHALL be distinct typed event proposals tied to the exact shipment and source. After source verification, only the authorized Purchase/Stock/Logistics/Transaction business command may execute a permitted transition with its own prerequisites. A supplier statement "booking complete" is evidence of a supplier-reported milestone, not conclusive terminal gate-in, loaded-on-vessel or completed international delivery; parent PO/SO totals derive from verified partial execution.
rules.positive: The Oct 8 supplier completion email and ticket 1728952 support a reviewable Load 1 shipped/loaded event; other four PO loads remain open and terminal gate-in remains unverified.
rules.negative: AI marks the five-container PO fulfilled or load delivered-to-port/at sea solely on a supplier email saying booking complete.

rules.title: Source-scoped status and human review observability
rules.owner: native Documents, Export exception presentation, Odoo Activities
rules.statement: Original received, extraction proposed, exact link pending, fields verified/applied, rejected, and downstream action accepted/refused SHALL be distinguishable source-backed statuses where needed using existing Odoo tracking and activity patterns. Document completeness SHALL be evaluated for the applicable shipment/milestone, not globally for an entire SO or four-load supplier PO.
rules.positive: Week 1 has current verified gate proof and week 2 document is missing; only week 1 shows its milestone complete.
rules.negative: A single Booking PDF marks every order line document-ready or suppresses unresolved extraction review.

rules.title: Current booking requirements are revision-bound Logistics input
rules.owner: Export current booking view; Logistics decision/dispatch owner
rules.statement: Export SHALL provide the exact current ocean booking, source revision, terminal/rail destination, ERD, cutoff, equipment requested and related shipment identities as read-only/typed input to Logistics. An ocean carrier reservation SHALL not be treated as the truck/drayage company commitment; Logistics owns drayage selection, accepted rate, work order and dispatcher state.
rules.positive: One of four weekly bookings contributes its own terminal cutoff and container type to its corresponding Logistics load.
rules.negative: An export edit directly sends a drayage order or changes an accepted freight rate.

rules.title: Independent supplier PO issue and later booking delivery
rules.owner: native Purchase report + Export booking QWeb + Linda sending owner
rules.statement: A legitimate approved supplier PO SHALL be independently issuable through Linda's existing native-Purchase release without an ocean booking, buyer, load, or fictitious order. Supplier readiness and current booking confirmation MAY arrive later. Each current applicable booking original or clearly labeled booking summary SHALL be issued separately as its own revision-bound supplier communication when authorized. If both PO and booking are eligible simultaneously, a single message MAY carry two separately recognizable PDFs; they SHALL NOT be fused into a new document authority. Later weekly bookings under a still-open multi-load PO do not create, reapprove, or automatically reissue the commercial PO. A reference copy of unchanged PO is allowed only under explicit audience/revision-safe policy. Preserve distinct recipient, issue purpose, source revision, attempt and delivery evidence for PO issuance and booking issuance.
rules.positive: PO 64014 is issued on September 4 without a booking; booking 6509024800 is later sent on September 30, linked to the same PO, without a new PO or duplicate send. A future multi-load PO sends each weekly booking separately.
rules.negative: PO waits for a booking, four weekly bookings produce four new POs, or a booking amendment silently reissues an unchanged PO or exposes the buyer's price.

rules.title: Carrier packet: booking and drayage Work Order, audience-safe
rules.owner: Logistics QWeb and authorized Linda sender; Export booking PDF source
rules.statement: Export drayage dispatch SHALL use a movement-specific current audience-safe booking PDF and a distinct drayage Work Order PDF plus only operation-required carrier instructions. The Work Order SHALL contain booking reference, equipment/chassis configuration, origin, terminal/ramp destination, pickup windows, supplier hours, ERD, cutoff, appointment and authorized contact context, without supplier buy price, buyer sell price, margin or unnecessary buyer identity. Existing domestic three-PDF dispatch remains unchanged for domestic movements.
rules.positive: Drayage trucker receives Booking and Work Order for its precise weekly load; domestic truck continues receiving its approved three-PDF packet.
rules.negative: Carrier is sent the buyer PO, supplier price, or a blanket three-document domestic packet for every ocean container.

rules.title: Material amendments protect pending commitments and mail
rules.owner: Logistics/Linda transition and Odoo Mail, Export provides booking version
rules.statement: A changed booking, ERD, cutoff, terminal, actual equipment request or material delivery condition SHALL identify the exact affected Logistics movement and pending release/dispatch work orders, queue items and carrier commitments. The authorized Logistics/Linda owner SHALL invalidate or reassess only affected pending artifacts, retain prior sent evidence, and request new rate, schedule or acknowledgment if required. No automatic rebooking, PO reissuance or repeat send is authorized; unknown send outcome remains unknown.
rules.positive: Week 3 cutoff moves and only week 3 pending work order is held for review; weeks 1, 2 and 4 remain intact.
rules.negative: AI amendment cancels all four shipments, reissues the supplier PO, or blindly retries an unknown-status email.
rules.cross_references: Logistics BRS-03-R022; BRS-05-R034; Linda send state.

rules.title: ERD and cutoff are terminal constraints, not supplier pickup dates
rules.owner: Export time values; Logistics pickup feasibility/appointments
rules.statement: For each specific load, Logistics SHALL plan a feasible supplier pickup and loaded gate-in from the current ERD, cutoff, terminal/ramp acceptance hours, appointments, loading duration, route transit, chassis/road constraints, buffer and authorized staging where used. ERD/cutoff SHALL NOT be converted directly into pickup appointments; inability to meet the window is a visible exception, not an invented ETA.
rules.positive: Logistics proposes week-2 pickup timed for the booked terminal acceptance slot, accounting for real supplier hours and travel.
rules.negative: A missing authorized staging yard is assumed or a date-only ERD is treated as 00:00 supplier pickup.

rules.title: Equipment-aware freight context and explicit commitments
rules.owner: Logistics freight context/booking owner
rules.statement: The equipment type, count, container/chassis constraints and requested movement intent SHALL be available to Logistics carrier/rate eligibility at the proper source. Freight reuse or rate confirmation SHALL not treat `equipment_class=None` as proof that a 40HC and a 20STD are equivalent. Binding to PO/owned material with no sale shall preserve company identity and approved authority independently of `sale_order_id`.
rules.positive: A 40HC drayage movement qualifies only for the correct equipment and approved carrier rate, with no buyer requirement for an authorized unsold-stock move.
rules.negative: A same-as-last rate applies to incompatible chassis because equipment context is missing; or no SO results in null company.
rules.cross_references: Observed `freight_context.py` equipment_class None and `load.py` company from SO.

rules.title: Terminal and voyage milestones have distinct evidence
rules.owner: Logistics delivery tracking + native Documents proof; Export display
rules.statement: Pickup, arrival at terminal, accepted gate-in/rail receipt, booking compliance, vessel load/sail, destination discharge, actual customer delivery and legal title/risk milestones SHALL remain distinct facts. Carrier-issued originals, terminal receipts and actor verification govern proof; no status is inferred solely from planned cutoff, a driver photo, a shipping booking or a scanned package.
rules.positive: A load has delivered-to-port proof while no vessel departure or buyer final-delivery fact exists.
rules.negative: Gate appointment alone marks ocean shipment sailed or customer invoice paid.

rules.title: Movement authorization not tied to buyer visibility
rules.owner: Logistics/Linda audience and buyer-optional movement policy
rules.statement: Carrier dispatch SHALL be authorized against exact company, physical load, approved purchase/stock and/or commercial order source, destination, booking when applicable, carrier acceptance, and movement-specific guards. An actual buyer MAY be present but is not necessary for every valid supplier-backed movement; if present, buyer identity remains shielded unless needed and authorized. Existing sales-specific buyer requirements SHALL remain in their legitimate sales workflow.
rules.positive: Buyerless stock relocation and ordinary buyer-linked sale both use Logistics with different validated eligibility; trucker only sees execution context.
rules.negative: Exporter invents a buyer to satisfy a global constraint, or PO-only movement bypasses all company and rate checks.

rules.title: Interpret the whole business correspondence package
rules.owner: Native Mail/Documents intake; AI extraction
rules.statement: Ingest the original email thread, individual messages, attachments, sender/recipient roles, time and quoted/forwarded context as separate attributed evidence without conflating message authors or treating quoted history as the latest instruction. Extract typed candidates from email body, PDF, XLSX and available source-linked photo evidence where accessible, with provenance for each value.
rules.positive: PO issued Sep 4, separate booking forwarded Sep 30, supplier reported completion Oct 8, later Oct 20 instruction remain four separately timed claims, all linked but not flattened into a single current statement.
rules.negative: The latest PDF filename or subject alone overwrites booking fields or an email quote is mistaken for a fresh carrier instruction.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Recognize document and message function, not just keywords
rules.owner: Native Documents classification; plasticos_documents verification
rules.statement: Classify supplier PO, supplier readiness response, ocean booking original, booking summary, amendment/roll notice, cancellation, shipping/loading statement, scale ticket, load spreadsheet, gate receipt and externally hosted picture link as distinct evidence types. Do not label an operator-generated booking summary as a carrier-issued original or assume a link equals received pictures.
rules.positive: AI recognizes 1728952 LOAD 1.pdf as a scale ticket and the supplier Oct 8 email as a completion assertion while the photograph link remains pending access/verification.
rules.negative: The phrase Booking Confirmation in a subject causes proof-of-vessel-load or all required loading photos to be marked verified.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Resolve booking-versus-PO-versus-physical load identities
rules.owner: plasticos_documents exact association; Export booking context
rules.statement: The matcher SHALL distinguish commercial PO 64014 from ocean booking 6509024800, link one PO to multiple separately executed bookings and one booking to its nominated count of containers, and link the actual physical container using corroborated container ID, ticket, seal and load index. It must not assume a single booking, PO, load, container, or supplier email are the same entity; ambiguous parent/child links require review.
rules.positive: XLSX row binds booking 6509024800, PO 64014, container CSNU8490558, seal 7695652, ticket 1728952, Load 1 without consuming all five PO units.
rules.negative: One 40HQ booking creates five loads or a generic vendor email attaches the ticket to an unrelated future booking.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Extract original booking attributes and missing-field truth
rules.owner: Native AI extraction; Export target schema
rules.statement: From a source booking confirmation, extract exact booking string, steamship line, vessel, voyage, equipment class/count, ERD, cargo cutoff with supplied time precision, empty pickup site, loaded return site, receipt/port evidence, freight or material weight restrictions and other fields explicitly supplied. For POL and POD, keep unknown unless an authoritative source explicitly identifies the maritime ports; do not silently substitute local terminal or place of receipt.
rules.positive: Booking PDF yields COSCO Shipping Lines, 1 x 40HQ, vessel CMA CGM JEAN GABRIEL, voyage MTE0, ERD Oct 5 and cutoff Oct 9 16:00, but explicit POD stays unknown.
rules.negative: The Long Beach empty pickup terminal is stored as Port of Discharge or the cutoff receives a fabricated time zone.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Capture roll reasons, classifications, capacity and continuity
rules.owner: Export booking history and supplier/carrier evidence
rules.statement: A notice of a rolled or revised booking SHALL retain source attribution, stated reason (distinct from inferred possibilities: supplier not ready, impossible freight, steamship-line cancellation, schedule/equipment change, unknown), affected booking/units, previous and candidate equipment quantities, vessel/voyage, cargo/document/VGM cutoff, terminal-specific ERD, ETD/ETA and relevant time zones. Where the booking number persists, treat multiple original files as version candidates and preserve each exact original and evidence timestamp. A later PDF, filename suffix or forwarded message does not independently prove the official chronology or replace another terminal's ERD. Distinguish same-booking revision, supplemental capacity, replacement booking and unresolved contradiction before emitting approved current fields to Logistics or externally issued documents.
rules.positive: The source PDFs with 3, 4 and 5 x 40HC under booking 6509024800, with a cutoff change from October 9 to October 12 and sailing change October 16 to 18, generate a sourced comparison and a separately reviewable terminal-ERD discrepancy; only accepted affected commitments are revalidated.
rules.negative: PDF filename ordering alone is treated as official issue chronology, competing terminal ERDs are flattened into one, an unrelated load is rescheduled, or a 1-container supplier summary is overwritten by an unverified 5-container email.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Maintain field-level current value, version, and approval
rules.owner: Export booking context; Documents verification
rules.statement: Each material field SHALL retain original raw value, parsed normalized value, source file/message locator, event time, supplier/carrier identity, assertion type, review status, effective time and superseded predecessor. A revised PDF using the same filename is distinct if content differs. An AI candidate becomes current only via an authorized deterministic policy: safe unambiguous initial fields may auto-apply when verified by controls, while conflicts, late changes and material dispatch-impacting values require review.
rules.positive: Oct 20 email offers 2 x 40HQ / Oct 26 ERD / Oct 30 cutoff as candidates; old 1 x 40HQ / Oct 5 / Oct 9 remain readable and operative until version/match authority is established.
rules.negative: AI picks a new cutoff just because email timestamp is later or treats same filename as identical content.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Use PO-level terms as constraints without copying financial values
rules.owner: Native Purchase, Documents evidence; Export/Logistics read
rules.statement: Extract and link PO-level quantity, material grade, unit, agreed trade label, delivery responsibility, minimum weight, conditional loading requirements, pictures, prohibited contamination and tare instructions as source-backed constraints. These remain authoritative native PO/contract business facts; Export displays applicability per shipping unit and may detect conflicts but SHALL NOT rewrite PO rate, quantity, pricing, AP/AR or transaction terms.
rules.positive: PO 64014 describes 200000 lb / 5 containers, FAS Port / Supplier Delivered, minimum 36000 lb per 40HQ and specified photo sequence, which are visible for each applicable load.
rules.negative: The scale ticket $0.03/lb overwrites the PO $0.04/lb or a pallet tare convention is replaced by a truck-scale tare.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Cross-check physical documents, not guessed shipping completion
rules.owner: plasticos_documents evidence; native Stock/Logistics movement owners
rules.statement: Reconcile shipper completion email, loading spreadsheet and signed scale ticket on exact PO, booking, load index, date, container, seal, pieces, gross/tare/net and document identities. Physical weights and counts are evidence candidates, not necessarily invoice weight or legal verified gross mass. If reported identifiers/quantities conflict, preserve all versions, produce an exception and forbid unauthorized state advancement.
rules.positive: Workbook gives Load 1, PO 64014, booking 6509024800, container CSNU8490558, 20 bales, seal 7695652, 40200 lb; ticket 1728952 confirms gross 72200, tare 32000, net 40200.
rules.negative: AI silently treats scale ticket $1206 total as the approved PO value or marks ocean departure from the shipper email.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Track externally hosted photos and document completeness honestly
rules.owner: Native Documents original/linked assets; plasticos_documents requirement verdict
rules.statement: Capture applicable loading-picture checklist from PO/booking, identify original pictures and external-link references, and show available, missing, inaccessible and verified status separately. Requirements may differ by PO and booking revision; no blanket global photo checklist, storage clone or fabricated proof. Native Documents stores originals or the authorized reference and PlasticOS Documents computes verification.
rules.positive: The supplier email reports a photo link, but actual photo count/compliance remains pending until the link is accessed and relevant images verified.
rules.negative: AI marks ten loading photos present and approved merely from a link title BKG 6509024800.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Guard shipment state changes and order balances
rules.owner: Native Purchase/Sale/Stock and Logistics/Transaction guarded commands
rules.statement: Extraction SHALL produce typed event proposals; only the owning business command may advance supplier ready, loaded, pickup, gate accepted, sailed, inventory receipt/delivery or commercial state after all movement-specific checks and idempotency. One approved 40200-lb physical shipment does not complete a 200000-lb/five-container supplier PO, other bookings, or a customer multi-load SO. No direct AI writes to transaction.state or load.state.
rules.positive: Load 1 recognized, with exact source evidence; the supplier PO retains a remaining balance computed through native order/stock execution and future bookings remain untouched.
rules.negative: Keyword booking complete causes all five units to close, sale invoice to post, or terminal gate-in to appear.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Propagate only a verified material change to the right consumers
rules.owner: Export publishes revisions; Logistics/Linda owns schedule/mail
rules.statement: When a verified current booking revision changes ERD, cutoff, vessel/voyage, terminal or requested equipment, Export SHALL publish the scoped booking-version delta. Logistics evaluates only impacted physical loads and pending commitments, holds/revalidates stale work orders and exact queued communications, while Linda retains sent and unknown send outcomes. Supplier PO and other sibling bookings remain intact; no automatic carrier booking/rebooking or sending outside authorized Logistics policies.
rules.positive: Only a load still awaiting gate-in under a verified rolled booking receives an at-risk schedule exception and revised supplier/carrier notice draft after approval.
rules.negative: AI cancels all five PO loads or regenerates/sends the approved PO automatically from a rolled booking.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: Offer a coordinator-style exception and audit view
rules.owner: Export sourced view + native Activity; Documents and Logistics originals
rules.statement: The operator SHALL be able to see which email/PDF/XLSX supplied each field, what changed since the prior booking, who asserted it, whether source is carrier-issued or supplier-reported, confidence and verification status, affected load(s), time-window feasibility, outstanding shipping photos/documents, and the next permitted owner action. Do not create a second case-management system or hidden auto-acceptance.
rules.positive: A review card shows Old: 1 x 40HQ/ERD Oct 5/Cutoff Oct 9; Candidate: 2 x 40HQ/ERD Oct 26/Cutoff Oct 30, together with booking-identity uncertainty and affected load status.
rules.negative: A summary displays one clean date, hiding material contradiction and provenance.
rules.cross_references: BRS-EXP-09; BRS-EXP-02; BRS-EXP-10; BRS-POS-02/03/10; exact owner correction needed

rules.title: FindTEU Phase 2 tracking adapter
rules.owner: plasticos_export integration boundary; provider is external evidence producer
rules.statement: Phase 2 SHALL include a separately configurable FindTEU adapter for available ocean container tracking and ETA/terminal milestones, using its documented API and authorized account. It SHALL be optional for operation of the core ERP and Phase 1, and SHALL not book carriers, set rates, dispatch drayage, perform stock movements or create a competing shipment registry.
rules.positive: An international shipment with FindTEU enabled displays source-labeled observed container milestones; the same Phase 1 booking works unchanged when the connector is disabled.
rules.negative: An unavailable FindTEU account blocks Phase 1 purchasing, receiving or Linda dispatch, or tracking status directly creates freight bookings.

rules.title: Exact container identity and optional booking-number tracking
rules.owner: plasticos_export typed mapping; native Odoo shipping identity remains canonical
rules.statement: The FindTEU adapter SHALL bind a company-scoped provider observation to the exact known container and applicable ocean booking, with carrier/SCAC when known, including bookings with many containers. Booking-level tracking SHALL never assign a provider event to every container merely because they share an ocean reservation. Unknown, reused or conflicting identifiers require review.
rules.positive: Booking 6509024800 has five containers: a tracking event for CSNU8490558 is linked only to that identified container and the correct journey.
rules.negative: A booking-number webhook blindly marks all five containers loaded, or an old container reuse event is attached to the current booking.

rules.title: Carrier observation is not commercial or stock authority
rules.owner: plasticos_export evidence projection with Logistics/Stock/Docs retained
rules.statement: FindTEU events SHALL preserve observed-at, effective event time, provider, raw payload reference, carrier, location, actual-vs-estimated designation, and normalized milestone; source timestamps and provider certainty shall remain visible. ETA, ETD, gate-in, vessel-loaded, discharge and provider completed flags SHALL NOT by themselves close a sale, prove title change, post invoices, verify documents or bypass guarded Logistics/Stock transitions.
rules.positive: Estimated port arrival changes and the UI updates the ETA with a source and timestamp but the Odoo sale and physical delivery states remain unchanged.
rules.negative: Provider "completed" automatically closes the customer invoice, asserts buyer delivery or documents Customs release.

rules.title: Rolls, replay, reversals and provider discrepancies
rules.owner: plasticos_export booking reconciliation; Logistics authorizes affected actions
rules.statement: FindTEU ingestion SHALL be replay-safe and idempotent, preserve previous observations, distinguish later ETA estimates from actual voyage or terminal changes, and flag contradictions with the current verified booking/terminal documentary source. A roll or cancellation SHALL require attributable authoritative booking evidence and affected-container review. Provider errors, stale updates and absent coverage SHALL appear as unknown/exception, not silently overwrite current booking terms.
rules.positive: A carrier roll causes a reviewable mismatch between the current booking PDF and tracking vessel/ETA; prior events remain inspectable, Linda receives a scoped change request only after approved booking revision.
rules.negative: An out-of-order webhook deletes a previous actual event or reschedules a confirmed drayage truck without approval.

rules.title: FindTEU tenancy, credentials, outages and coverage gate
rules.owner: platform integration/security owner; Export is a consumer
rules.statement: FindTEU integration SHALL use tenant-isolated authorization and protected API keys, authenticated webhook ingress using a validated provider-supported verification design, quotas, bounded retries and error classification; protect commercial identity in outbound requests. It SHALL be feature-gated until provider contractual access, supported-carrier coverage, webhook security and a real-booking read-only proof pass. It SHALL not fabricate tracking status when provider data is missing.
rules.positive: A tenant-scoped API credential successfully tracks a supported container and isolates its webhook events from other companies; provider outage yields a visible no-fresh-data exception.
rules.negative: An untrusted webhook changes another tenant shipment, or a missing token yields a fabricated on-time event or prevents native order handling.

rules.title: AESDirect Phase 2 EEI filing support, not autonomous filing
rules.owner: authorized USPPI/agent/filer and applicable regulator; Export filing context only
rules.statement: Phase 2 SHALL support ACE AESDirect EEI preparation, an applicability/exemption decision, the legally responsible USPPI or authorized agent, and status/evidence visibility. It SHALL NOT infer a mandatory EEI from an Incoterm or international booking alone, claim a regulatory determination absent the required facts, file EEI without an authorized filer, or require an AES account for Phase 1 or shipments outside applicable requirements.
rules.positive: The authorized exporter identifies a reportable shipment, selects the responsible filer and prepares an evidence-backed filing case; another exempt case documents its actual exemption basis.
rules.negative: Every FAS shipment is automatically marked as requiring AES or as filed merely because the shipment has an ocean booking.

rules.title: Validate and assemble filing data from existing business sources
rules.owner: native Odoo Sale/Purchase/Stock and authorized compliance reviewer; Export orchestration
rules.statement: The AESDirect filing preparation view SHALL source reportable commodity classification, destination, value, quantities, UOM, dates, parties, port, transport and shipment identifiers from their correct native owner and explicit reviewed inputs. Missing or uncertain EEI elements SHALL remain incomplete and be surfaced before handoff; AI extraction may propose facts but must not silently supply legal classification, reporting party, value, license or exemption determinations.
rules.positive: A four-container shipment prepares the filing data with traceable stock, commercial and booking references and flags an unverified Schedule B/HS mapping for review.
rules.negative: A shipping booking PDF alone causes AI to fill an unverified Schedule B and value and claim EEI ready.

rules.title: Official AESDirect portal, WebLink or supported bulk handoff
rules.owner: authorized filer; connector only prepares supported handoff
rules.statement: Initial Phase 2 integration SHALL provide an authorized-user filing handoff to ACE AESDirect with a reviewable data packet and, where tested and approved, its documented WebLink Submission API for prepopulating the portal or a validated AESTIR/X12 bulk-upload file. AES WebLink still requires the filer to sign in, complete missing elements and submit in the official system. This requirement does NOT authorize an uncertified direct AES transmission service or unattended government filing.
rules.positive: The responsible filer reviews the proposed EEI data, follows a working validated WebLink/portal handoff, manually submits, and returns with an official response.
rules.negative: An API implementation posts an uncertified EEI directly to AES or labels a prepared WebLink payload "filed".

rules.title: Official response, ITN or exemption evidence and errors
rules.owner: authorized filing authority + native Documents/PlasticOS verification
rules.statement: Only the official AES acceptance response and Internal Transaction Number (ITN), or applicable legally supported exemption evidence, SHALL support the corresponding filing outcome. Record filer, authoritative source, acceptance/rejection status, timestamp, exact shipment/export record and document original; reject ambiguous source matches and preserve rejected messages. Export SHALL display the verified projection and Logistics/other owners may consume it only according to their own lawful guarded workflow.
rules.positive: A supported AES acknowledgment returns ITN for the intended company and shipment; the original is attached once and the status indicates accepted with traceable source.
rules.negative: The presence of a draft filing CSV, emailed arbitrary number or filename containing "AES" marks the export officially accepted.

rules.title: Amendments, cancellations, access control and certification boundary
rules.owner: authorized filer and platform security; Export only coordinates evidence
rules.statement: Phase 2 filing corrections, voids, late amendments, role authorization and disclosures SHALL follow applicable official filing rules through the authorized filer. Keep the original filing decision, revised data, ITN/rejection evidence and source-linked audit trail. Optional certified direct transmission is DEFERRED as a separate future authorization/certification decision, not included in this Phase 2 scope. Failure or missing permissions SHALL fail closed without changing native order/invoice or stock state.
rules.positive: A corrected value prompts the responsible filer to amend via the authorized filing route; old ITN and amendment evidence remain linked and an exception is visible until reconciled.
rules.negative: AI silently edits an already accepted EEI or a non-filer account transmits a correction, and original evidence is erased.

rules.title: Primary booking identity and existing six critical fields
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
